SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Manager, did you find the external hard drive?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Are you telling me to find it?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: My last memory is leaving it on your desk...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我最后一次看见U盘就是在您的工位上…

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Minha última lembrança é de ter deixado ele na sua mesa...

SCRIPT.FRENCH: Mon dernier souvenir, c’est que je l’ai laissé sur votre bureau...

แน่ใจนะว่ามันไม่อยู่ตรงนั้น?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If it’s not there, I don’t know where it is...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 如果您工位上没有的话，那我也是真不知道在哪…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 如果您工位上沒有的話，那我也是真不知道在哪…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you know how important that is!

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Coba cari lebih teliti, pasti ada di sana!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tenho certeza de que está lá, se você procurar direito!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Если нормально поискать, он точно там!
